audience: clinicians and health IT teams that read FHIR records in a Medplum project

useCases.title: Review the chart of one patient
useCases.text: Find one patient, then list the encounters, conditions and allergies recorded for that patient.

useCases.title: Check recent observations
useCases.text: List the lab results and vital signs recorded for one patient.

useCases.title: Review medication requests
useCases.text: List the medication requests, or prescriptions, recorded for one patient.

useCases.title: Look up appointments and practitioners
useCases.text: List appointments for one patient or one practitioner's schedule, and search practitioners by name.

useCases.title: Read one FHIR resource by id
useCases.text: Read one resource by its type and id, for example a Patient, Encounter, Location or Organization.
